package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gorm_bootstrap_with_raw_sql_repositories_without_adapter_boundary: Codebases that bootstrap persistence with GORM but run repository queries through raw SQL without a clear adapter boundary.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Rule056PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}

func scenario056Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) ([]Rule056PositiveRecord, error) {
	var items []Rule056PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}

func scenario056PositiveRaw(db *gorm.DB, tenantID string) ([]Rule056PositiveRecord, error) {
	var items []Rule056PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Raw("SELECT * FROM rule_056_positive_records WHERE tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Scan(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}
